author: i_zeram
text:
⚡️The hacker who leaked GTA VI content was sentenced to seven years in prison but released the same day, according to Neowin.

21-year-old Arion Kurtaj, who suffers from severe autism, hacked Rockstar Games in 2022 and published 90 videos from the game.

He had previously been sent to a psychiatric hospital for mandatory treatment. The court, taking into account the time he spent in the hospital and in custody, released the hacker on probation. He will serve the remainder of his sentence under supervised release.
